paragraphs.text: Mila is a magical foxlike creature native to Arcavios , and is the partner to the planeswalker Lukka on the plane .

When threatened, she is capable of summoning scorching flames to protect herself. When Lukka arrived on the plane , Mila began to follow him around, something which Lukka begrudgingly accepted. After magically "bonding" together due to Lukka's powers, a true partnership began to emerge.

Mila is trapped under some rocks and is released by Lukka , who was wandering through Arcavios . In return, she brings fruits and nuts to the hungry planeswalker . From there she starts to follow Lukka until a bond is made between the two, after Mila saves Lukka from a Dragonsguard. During the confrontation between Kasmina and Lukka, Kasmina traps Mila in a sphere of magic.
